fullContentHtml:
AFCAT 01/2027 Online Form – Full Details

Indian Air Force (Bhartiya Vayu Sena) has released the notification for the post of AFCAT 01/2027 Batch (January 2028 Course). This recruitment has been issued for 379 posts. The online application process for AFCAT 01/2027 Recruitment will start from 12 November 2026, and candidates can apply till 11 December 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for AFCAT 01/2027 Recruitment, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 November 2026
  • Last Date : 11 December 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 December 2026
  • Course Start : January 2028
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • For All Candidates : Rs. 550/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Download Short Notice
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is AFCAT 01/2027 Online Form?

AFCAT 01/2027 Online Form is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
